notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: What happened in your projects: posts, approvals, accounts and AI.
notifications.empty: No notifications. We'll let you know here when something is published, fails or needs your approval.
notifications.retention: Read notifications are deleted automatically after 90 days.

prefs.title: Notifications
prefs.body: Choose which notifications you want to see inside Kreo. We don't send emails yet.

types.approval_pending: Posts waiting for approval (admins and owners)

post_published_warn.title: Published on {platform} (with warnings)
post_published_warn.body: {post} · {account}. An optional step was not completed: {warnings}.

account_issue.title: Reconnect {platform}
account_issue.body: The connection with {account} has expired or has an error. Go to Accounts and reconnect it to keep publishing.

inbox_issue.title: Inbox: reconnect {channel}
inbox_issue.body: The inbox connection with {channel} has expired. Reconnect it in the Inbox.

youtube_consent_expiring.title: YouTube permission expires soon
youtube_consent_expiring.body: While Google keeps Kreo "In testing", the permission lasts 7 days. The one for {account} expires on {date}: disconnect and reconnect it in Accounts before then.

ai_done.title: Your {kind} is ready
ai_done.body: It's already in the Studio library.

ai_failed.title: The AI generation failed
ai_failed.body: Your {kind} could not be created. {credits} credits have been refunded.

weekly_summary.title: Weekly summary · {project}
weekly_summary.body: {published} published · {failed} failed · {scheduled} scheduled this week · {overdue} overdue tasks

reasons.token_expired: The account connection has expired: reconnect it in Accounts.
reasons.missing_tokens: The account has no saved permission: reconnect it in Accounts.
reasons.account_not_active: The account is disconnected or expired: reconnect it in Accounts.
reasons.post_not_found: The post was deleted before it was published.
reasons.video_required: This network needs a video and the post has none.
reasons.unsupported_media: The file format is not supported by this network.
reasons.privacy_not_allowed: The chosen visibility is not allowed for this account (unaudited TikTok apps can only post privately).
reasons.rate_limited: The network is limiting posts right now. Try rescheduling it later.
reasons.unavailable: The network did not respond. Try rescheduling it in a while.
reasons.media_processing_failed: The network could not process the file. Check the format and duration.
reasons.media_processing_timeout: The network took too long to process the file.
reasons.publish_timeout: The network took too long to confirm the post. Check your profile before posting it again.
reasons.upload_failed: The file could not be uploaded to the network.
reasons.upload_init_failed: The network refused to start the upload. Check the account permissions.
reasons.quota: The network's daily API quota is used up. It can be retried tomorrow.
reasons.unknown: The network rejected the post. Check the file and the account permissions.

weekly.followersNote: Change over the last 7 days. YouTube is shown separately and never added up (its API rules).
weekly.nothingScheduled: Nothing scheduled. Check the free slots in the calendar.

bestTimes.title: Best times
bestTimes.subtitle: When to post on each network. Madrid time.
bestTimes.defaultNote: Indicative pattern based on public industry studies. With {min} posts with metrics we start using your own data.
bestTimes.youtubeNote: YouTube: indicative pattern only (its rules don't allow combining its data with other sources to create metrics).
bestTimes.noAccounts: Connect an account to see its best times.
